action_instruction: Checking the Whole Milk substitution preference
intent: whether the Substitution preferences card lists Whole Milk, 1 gal with the Same brand only preference

action_params.condition: The "Substitution preferences" card shows "Whole Milk, 1 gal" with "Same brand only".
action_params.query: whether the Substitution preferences card lists Whole Milk, 1 gal with the Same brand only preference
action_params.code_js: (() => { const text = el(15).innerText; return text.includes('Whole Milk, 1 gal') && text.includes('Same brand only'); })()

action_instruction: Checking the Honey Wheat Bread substitution preference
intent: whether the Substitution preferences card lists Honey Wheat Bread with the Pick the best available match preference

action_params.condition: The "Substitution preferences" card shows "Honey Wheat Bread" with "Pick the best available match".
action_params.query: whether the Substitution preferences card lists Honey Wheat Bread with the Pick the best available match preference
action_params.code_js: (() => { const text = el(15).innerText; return text.includes('Honey Wheat Bread') && text.includes('Pick the best available match'); })()

assertion_tree.description: the "Substitution preferences" card shows "Whole Milk, 1 gal" with "Same brand only" and "Honey Wheat Bread" with "Pick the best available match"

sub_results.description: The "Substitution preferences" card shows "Whole Milk, 1 gal" with "Same brand only".
The "Substitution preferences" card shows "Honey Wheat Bread" with "Pick the best available match".

assertion_tree.verification: The current page displays the "Substitution preferences" card with both specified substitution preferences.
